title: Freeze-readiness evidence for the shared-kernel catalog

role_assignments._run_id_disambiguation: /claude/r0_steward (Anthropic) is THIS package's Integration Owner and must record its own capability declaration before this package leaves backlog. /root/r0_steward (OpenAI Codex) is a DIFFERENT run: it is the Integration Owner of WP-0A-A0-001 and WP-0A-CON-001 and is named in open_blockers solely because it must countersign the amendments made to those two packages and record the WP-0A-CON-001 npm run check addendum. Neither run substitutes for the other. Independent testing flagged the near-identical names as ambiguous; both are intended.

independence.cross_vendor_exception: prefer_cross_vendor_review is NOT satisfied: every assigned run is Anthropic claude-opus-5. The Decision Register (§ cross-vendor review) permits this only as an explicit exception - 'if there is no cross-vendor capacity, use an independent agent per run and record the exception'. Each of the five roles is a separate agent run with its own capability declaration and no run reviewed, tested, or integrated its own work. The Integration Owner must carry this exception forward; it is not waived and it is not equivalent to cross-vendor review.

required_human_authorities: A6 sign-off for CTR-AUD-001, CTR-OBS-001 and CTR-USG-001
purpose: Ten shared-kernel contracts are still Draft, and the Decision Register permits only exploratory spikes against a Draft contract. Every consumer package waiting to build a fake or a consumer test is blocked on that, while nine of the ten already carry the schema and fixtures Candidate v1 asks for. This package gathers the evidence for each contract against its OWN required_before_freeze list and puts it in front of the owners. It changes no status: promotion is a decision its owner and the Product Owner make.

include: RFC-2026-010 recording, per contract, which required_before_freeze items are present and by what artifact
An explicit statement of what the check does NOT establish, item by item
Routing of the four co-owned contracts to A1 and A6 rather than promoting them
A machine-written verification record, and the runner-side check that a stale record fails the build
A branch-scope guard: what a branch CHANGED, checked against what its package declares
A pinned catalog registry: every contract's freeze level, owner and freeze requirements, and the index that must agree with them
Conformance and truthfulness checks over every author handoff
A command that rebuilds the integrity manifest, which four documents already told someone to do without one existing

Per-contract freeze readiness of eleven of the twelve contracts G1 consumes (eight Candidate toward Frozen v1; CTR-SEC-001, CTR-AUD-001 and CTR-OBS-001 toward Candidate v1), naming each blocker and its owner, without changing any status. CTR-NTF-001, the twelfth, is listed with what main records about it and is not assessed (scope.exclude); amended 2026-10-08 on C0 F-3
exclude: Any change to a contract status, in a manifest, in the catalog index or in the Decision Register
CTR-NTF-001, which A5 owns and which this package does not assess
Mutation coverage as a promotion criterion; it is quoted as context and is not a bar
Production schema, migrations, provider calls and every other Gate G0 restriction

amends_without_owning.rationale: Only what this branch changes outside its own writable paths, and nothing else. test-kits/integrity-manifest.json (owned by WP-0A-A0-002) carries the content digest of work-packages/WP-0A-CON-008.json, so recording the 2026-10-08 G1 freeze-readiness increment in this manifest moves exactly that one digest line, regenerated by npm run regenerate:manifest and not edited by hand. scripts/test-suite-contract.mjs was listed here for the previous increment and is not any more: this increment adds no test, so no floor and no name digest moved. evidence/VERIFICATION.md is in this package's own writable_paths, so it is not an amendment.

acceptance_criteria: Every required_before_freeze item is assessed against the shipped schema and fixture list, not against a fixture count.
The assessment states plainly that it establishes PRESENCE of an artifact and not that the artifact satisfies the intent behind the phrase, with the specific items where that gap is widest named.
No contract status changes anywhere in the repository.
Contracts with a co-owner are routed to that co-owner rather than proposed for promotion by A0 alone.
npm run check stays green with no test skipped.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. One decision record and one manifest; no code, no contract, no schema and no status changed.
open_blockers: CORRECTED 2026-10-08 BY A0 (/claude/a0_atlas) IN PLACE, RECORD CORRECTION, NOT A NEW FINDING (index kept): RFC-2026-010 is no longer Proposed. Its status line reads 'Partially approved 2026-09-02': the Product Owner approved the five A0-owned promotions (CTR-API-001, CTR-PAG-001, CTR-IDM-001, CTR-MOD-001, CTR-FLG-001), which are Candidate. STILL OPEN: CTR-SEC-001 awaits A1's promotion signature, CTR-AUD-001 and CTR-OBS-001 await A6's countersignature of their 2026-10-07 bound values, CTR-USG-001's promotion is undisposed, and CTR-NTF-001 is A5's (evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/g1-freeze-readiness-2026-10-08.md §3). Text as recorded: RFC-2026-010 is Proposed. Until the Product Owner disposes of it, every contract stays Draft and consumers stay limited to exploratory spikes.
A1 and A6 sign-off is outstanding for four contracts and cannot be represented by an agent.

The freeze check establishes presence, not sufficiency. Four items are named in the RFC where a script cannot see what the phrase meant: stable ordering, auth rules, decimal money and bounded cardinality.
CTR-NTF-001 remains unassessed; A5 owns it.

ADDED 2026-10-08 BY A0 (/claude/a0_atlas), RESTORED ON A1 N-2 AND C0 I-2 (evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/a1-review-2026-10-07.md §3), OWNER WP-0A-A0-003 (the package that owns scripts/scan-repository-secrets.mjs), NOT A CONDITION ON THIS PACKAGE'S MERGE: a SHA-256 digest can contain a Luhn-valid 13-to-19 digit run by coincidence, and test-kits/integrity-manifest.json is a file of such digests rewritten whenever a protected file changes; scripts/scan-repository-secrets.mjs then correctly reports a payment card number, with no allowlist by design. This branch, first spelled WP-0A-CON-008-sweep-age-floor, tripped it once; the rename that changed the digest was a workaround and not a fix, and about one regenerated digest in 3,100 will trip it again on any package. The offending run is not reproduced here, because quoting it fails the scan. An exemption in the scanner is reserved for a reviewed decision by its owner. The entry lived only in this package's author handoff until the 2026-10-08 increment dropped it; it is kept here so the next author finds a diagnosis, not a mystery. AMENDED 2026-10-08 BY A0 (/claude/a0_atlas) IN PLACE ON A1 RE-CHECK N-2 (evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/a1-recheck-2026-10-07.md §3), RECORD CORRECTION (index kept): the figure first recorded was 'one in a few hundred'; A1 measured 65 trips in 200,000 random digests passed through the scanner's own scanText on a manifest-shaped line, about one in 3,100. No guard copies this entry into the author handoff; it is copied there by hand.

ADDED 2026-10-08 BY A0 (/claude/a0_atlas) ON C0 F-1 AND A1 N-1 (evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/c0-review-2026-10-07.md §2, a1-review-2026-10-07.md §3), OWNER PRODUCT OWNER + A0 (G0-024), A GATE-RULE QUESTION THIS PACKAGE DOES NOT DECIDE: Decision Register §1.2 (line 43) and §5.1 (line 190) define Frozen v1 as a contract that has passed G0, while §7.2 G0 Pass Rule item 2 (line 365) requires the contracts the First Slice uses to be Frozen v1 before G0 passes. Read as two events in sequence this is a cycle; read as one event, the freeze review of the First-Slice contracts is part of the G0 exit. Which reading governs, and whether a conditional G0 exit (WP-0A-A0-010 as the G1/G2 plan describes it) may waive §7.2 (2), is not decided on main; CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md sends a gate-rule change through an RFC. Under either reading no contract moves today: each of the eight Candidates has its own open, owned items (evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/g1-freeze-readiness-2026-10-08.md §2).

ADDED 2026-10-08 BY A0 (/claude/a0_atlas) ON A1 RE-CHECK N-3 (evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/a1-recheck-2026-10-07.md §4; also C0 N-2, Q0 O-1, R0 RC-3 in their 2026-10-07 re-checks), OWNER WP-0A-CON-008 (its writable_paths hold scripts/refresh-author-handoff.mjs), GUARD INTEGRITY, NOT A CONDITION ON THIS PACKAGE'S MERGE: npm run check:handoff and test-kits/handoff-conformance.test.mjs compare the handoff's cited head with branchTipBefore(), which for a non-merge HEAD is always HEAD^, so that a handoff need not cite the commit that contains it. Nothing checks that HEAD is the handoff commit, so whatever the last commit carries is outside the comparison. Measured at e601ea28, whose handoff cited 8526ca67 and whose own commit modified work-packages/WP-0A-CON-008.json: check:handoff exited 0 and conformance passed 19 of 19, and CI read the same HEAD^. A green handoff guard is therefore evidence only when git show --stat HEAD shows the handoff alone. Fix sketch for the owner to decide: when HEAD does not modify handoffs/<package>-author-handoff.json, compare the cited head with HEAD itself, keep HEAD^ only for the commit that carries the refresh, and add a negative-control test in which a last commit that changes a manifest and not the handoff exits DRIFTED. Until then reviewers check the last-and-alone rule by hand.
